duration_basis: The stored duration remains a planning allowance, not a qualified runtime prediction for staged statics. Prior pre-flight timing and diagnostic records require numerical reconciliation before rescheduling.
template_digest_basis: UTF-8 source text normalized to LF; SOURCE_SHA256 in the runner manifest records that digest.
criteria_basis: Joint angle criteria, yield strength and stress design factor require an external criteria file; criteria-form.json contains no numerical defaults. The report and driver require --criteria. The top-tension estimate is an assumed criterion value, not the modelled tension. Connected assembly capacity is not established.
method: vessel offset applied as a static mean position; no prescribed vessel motion; no wave is applied: this sweep covers vessel offset and current only

extraction.period: main stage only; stage index one; build-up excluded
extraction.lower_angle: Flex Joint Rigid Piece, End B, connection-relative Ez-Angle; mean and maximum absolute degrees
extraction.upper_angle: Riser Slip Joint, End A, connection-relative Ez-Angle; mean and maximum absolute degrees
extraction.top_tension: Riser, End A, Effective tension; minimum and maximum kN
extraction.stroke: Tensioner Ring vertical displacement from initial elevation relative to fixed vessel; minimum and maximum m; not individual tensioner-link extension
extraction.stress: Riser, Max von Mises stress range-graph maximum; native kN/m2 converted to MPa
extraction.qualification: Actual channel availability, units and interpretation require native readback before engineering acceptance. Missing channels and incomplete states are refused.

retention: Every completed case retains summary metrics and input identity. Native simulation files remain only for the greatest normalized criterion demand at each current speed; the first case resolves ties. Stale summaries are preserved outside the progress glob.
recovery: A solver-version change requires a new output directory and a complete rerun. Preserve the previous output directory as evidence. A criteria-file change also requires a new output directory and a complete rerun.
approval_steps: Re-pin ref to the merged commit.
Replace every SOLVER_REPO_DIR placeholder, including progress.glob; copy the manifest under the campaign-id filename generic-drilling-riser-r1.json.
Supply the external criteria file and replace CRITERIA_FILE; retain its digest with the results.
Run runner validation against the resolved approval copy.
Add its new digest to approvals.tsv only after approval.
screen_comparison_boundary: The analytical screen uses constant assumed top tension and uniform drag with pinned ends. Both joint-angle comparisons are omitted because constant tension can introduce an error of about a factor of two. Weight treats the above-water 20 m as submerged, underestimating column weight by about 1.0 %. Stress remains approximate. Attached members, pressure stress and nonlinear tensioners are omitted. Geometric extension is not a mechanical stroke prediction.
release_boundary: External sharing of results and method remains conditional on maintainer acceptance of the derivative basis and redistribution terms.
tension_acceptance_basis: The stored minimum top tension is retained as an assumed criterion. The minimum remains 8,345.7 kN. Native pre-flight statics on the earlier models, reported on #2469, give the main-riser top effective tension below this criterion in every converged case; numerical reconciliation remains pending access to the diagnostic records. The four links share their vertical load between the riser, choke and kill lines and the slip joint; total tensioner force is not main-riser top effective tension. No operating window is established. Requalify the staged method case by case before production; the prior pre-flight does not qualify the changed method.
statics_method: Use calculate_staged_statics from scripts/orcaflex/run_generic_drilling_riser_campaign.py for pre-flight and campaign execution. After zero-current equilibrium at the specified offset, ramp through 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% of target current using the CURRENT_RAMP precedent in src/digitalmodel/drilling_riser/campaign.py::_statics_path. Retain calculated positions before every current change; require InStaticState at every stage. No vessel-offset continuation is applied. Direct CalculateStatics does not test this method. Preserve initial ring reference before calculated positions are applied.
preflight_requirements: Record the reviewed source revision and model digests; re-review before native execution.
Load every case and record errors, warnings, draught and P-y readback.
Validate each includes/*.yml with the production YAML validator.
Use calculate_staged_statics for every case; record stage outcomes, elapsed time, iteration evidence, top and bottom effective tensions and ring and drill-string positions.
Record per-case contact forces and confirm Relationship1 through Relationship4 are present and enabled.
Repeat the specified short dynamics after staged statics; record durations, normal stop and retained-channel readback against the approved QA criteria.
Reconcile prior diagnostic records and tension observations before production; a timeout or cancelled solve is not equilibrium.
retry_limitations: Runner retries may repeat deterministic statics failures and configuration failures. A retry or longer timeout is not evidence of convergence.
